title: Kinase-dead BRAF and oncogenic RAS cooperate to drive tumor progression through CRAF
central_claims: Kinase-dead BRAF cooperates with oncogenic RAS through CRAF to activate MEK–ERK signaling and promote melanoma; selective BRAF inhibitors can paradoxically activate this pathway in RAS-mutant cells.

source_manifest.title: Experiments from unfinished Registered Reports in the Reproducibility Project: Cancer Biology
source_manifest.finding: Partial replication supported inhibitor response in BRAF-mutant cells but the D04/SB590885 activation comparison was not significant; construct-expression problems prevented the planned mechanistic tests.

source_manifest.title: RAF inhibitors transactivate RAF dimers and ERK signalling in cells with wild-type BRAF.
source_manifest.finding: Independent chemical-genetic experiments support RAS-dependent inhibitor-mediated RAF dimer transactivation, with differences in RAF isoform requirements.

source_manifest.title: Mechanism and consequences of RAF kinase activation by small-molecule inhibitors.
source_manifest.finding: Independent review retains kinase-dead BRAF/oncogenic RAS cooperation and discusses paradoxical activation mechanisms and therapeutic consequences.
